mapper.select: WITH bounds AS ( SELECT date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS today_start ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users) AS total_users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE created_at >= now() - INTERVAL '30 days') AS new_users_30d, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE last_login_at >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS active_users_7d, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cats) AS total_cats, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cats WHERE created_at >= now() - INTERVAL '30 days') AS new_cats_30d, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sightings) AS total_sightings, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sightings WHERE taken_at >= b.today_start) AS today_sightings, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sightings WHERE taken_at >= b.today_start - INTERVAL '1 day' AND taken_at < b.today_start) AS yesterday_sightings FROM bounds b

WITH days AS ( SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - g.n AS day FROM generate_series(0, #{days} - 1) AS g(n) ) SELECT d.day, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sightings s WHERE (s.taken_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date = d.day) AS sighting_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cats c WHERE (c.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date = d.day) AS new_cat_count FROM days d ORDER BY d.day
SELECT t.cat_count, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM (SELECT u.id, COUNT(c.id) AS cat_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN cats c ON c.user_id = u.id GROUP BY u.id) t GROUP BY t.cat_count
SELECT id AS user_id, display_name AS email, last_login_at FROM users WHERE last_login_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY last_login_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
